hooks.name: Block staging large/ignored files
hooks.description: Prevents accidentally staging large graph artifacts, parquet files, or raw data into git

action.prompt:
Before running any git add or git commit command, verify:
1. No files from graph/ directory are being staged (they are in .gitignore)
2. No .parquet, .csv (from data/raw/), or .pdf files are being staged
3. No file larger than 100KB is being added
If any of these would be violated, refuse the command and explain why.
